prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.4 °C (66% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.4 °C (57% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.8 °C (49% above healthy). Thermal equilibrium is compromised, causing fluid temperature to rise well above nominal operating limits.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.97 s (within 2% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.58 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 363 W·min/l (5% below healthy). No internal bypassing detected; volumetric efficiency is optimal.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 45.8 bar (within 2% of healthy). Hydraulic dampening shows early wear with mildly heightened ripple during load transitions.
